description: This file defines the ProductPrice class, an entity representing pricing details for products in an e-commerce system. It includes fields such as price amount, type, special dates, and relationships to descriptions and availability.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: Entity class representing the product price, including amount, type, special conditions, and related descriptions and availability.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the ProductPrice entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the ProductPrice entity.

methods.name: getProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Returns the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: setProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Sets the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date of the special price period, cloned to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the special price period, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date of the special price period, cloned.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the special price period, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the special price amount, if any.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Sets the special price amount.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with the price.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Assigns the descriptions for the product price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Checks whether this price is marked as the default price.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets the default price indicator.

methods.name: getProductAvailability
methods.description: Gets the availability details associated with this price.

methods.name: setProductAvailability
methods.description: Sets the availability details for this price.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the price.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier for the price.

methods.name: setProductPriceType
methods.description: Sets the type of the price (e.g., one-time, recurring).

methods.name: getProductPriceType
methods.description: Gets the type of the price.
